CREATE TABLE t1(a, b, c); 
  INSERT INTO t1 VALUES(1, 2, 3);

INSERT INTO t1 SELECT
        ((a<<3) + b) & 2147483647,
        ((b<<3) + c) & 2147483647,
        ((c<<3) + a) & 2147483647
      FROM t1 ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH r(x,y) AS (
          SELECT 1, $::str
          UNION ALL
          SELECT x+1, $::str FROM r
          LIMIT 200
      )
      SELECT count(x), length(y) FROM r GROUP BY (x%5)

WITH r(x,y) AS (
          SELECT 100, $::str
          UNION ALL
          SELECT x-1, $::str FROM r
          LIMIT 100
      )
      SELECT count(x), length(y) FROM r GROUP BY y COLLATE utf16bin, (x%5)

WITH r(x,y) AS (
            SELECT 300, $::str2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT x-1, $::str2 FROM r
            LIMIT 300
        )
        SELECT count(x), length(y) FROM r GROUP BY y, (x%5)

INSERT INTO t1 SELECT
        ((a<<3) + b) & 2147483647,
        ((b<<3) + c) & 2147483647,
        ((c<<3) + a) & 2147483647
      FROM t1 ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX i1 ON t1(a,b,c)
